However, disabling some types of cookies or similar technologies may impact your experience when using our sites. The use of third-party cookies or similar technologies for targeted advertising may constitute a sale or sharing of personal information under the California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) or other various laws. You may have the right to opt out of the use of cookies or similar technologies for these purposes, depending on your state of residence. To opt out, ensure that processing for Targeted Advertising and Social Media purposes is disabled, below if shown. Please note, these controls only opt you out of targeted advertising and any sales/sharing related to targeted advertising. In order to exercise your right to opt out of all sales/sharing by AEG, you may visit ourprivacy rights portal. You may opt out of all cookies/similar technologies (except those that are essential or functional) by changing your settings, below. The cookie preference tool is device and browser specific. If you delete or clear cookies or change devices or browsers, you may need to reset your cookie preferences. You may also enable the Global Privacy Control to opt out of targeted advertising and limit related sales/sharing of your data. More informationAllow All Manage Consent PreferencesSocial Media Cookies Social Media Cookies These cookies are set by social media services that we have added to the site to allow you to share content through social media sites. These social media providers may collect information about your use of our sites, or other sites on the web, and may develop a profile about your interests and behaviors based on such usage. This may affect your experience and the content you see on those social networks. If you disable these technologies, sharing functionality may be disabled. Essential CookiesAlways ActiveThese technologies are necessary for us to deliver our services to you. For example, these technologies allow us to load content on the page, perform security functions, or store mandatory preferences (e.g. opt-out of sale preferences). These technologies cannot be disabled, and if you configure your browser to block these features, our services or certain features may not function.Targeted Advertising Cookies Targeted Advertising Cookies These cookies enable us and our advertising partners to serve you with relevant targeted advertisements based on your interests and profiles held by us or our advertising partners and ad networks. You might see these advertisements on our sites or on other sites you visit. These technologies may collect information about you on our site, as well as third-party sites, and these technologies may be used to associate the information collected across sites and contexts. If you disable these technologies, you will still see ads, but they may be less relevant. Analytics Cookies Analytics Cookies These technologies are used to analyze the use and performance of our services so that we can measure and improve those services. For example, we may create analytics designed to understand how many people visit our websites, how they reach us, how they navigate the services, how the service performs, and what content is popular. This allows us to improve your experience on our services, and if you disable these services, our sites may not perform optimally. Functional CookiesAlways ActiveThese technologies are used to provide specific features or functions of our site or to personalize your experience. For example, these technologies are used to maintain log-in sessions for registered users or to store your preferences (e.g. regarding the use of cookies). If you disable these technologies, the features may not function properly, and you may be required to reconfigure your preferences.
